question: What is the meaning of (predictive) building circularity indicator in relation to performance indicators (an interpretation of the ce performance of a product)?
data_group: performance indicators (an interpretation of the ce performance of a product)
description: The building circularity indicator (CI) measures the extent to which a building's construction, use, and end-of-life phases minimize linear flow and maximize restorative flow. It assesses the circularity of a building based on the materials used, the waste generated, and the potential for reuse and recycling. The CI is calculated using three performance indicators: the fraction of recycled materials, the fraction of rapidly renewable materials, and the fraction of reused products and/or components. These indicators evaluate the circularity of a building's construction phase, use phase, and end-of-life phase, respectively. The CI provides a score between 0 and 100, indicating the level of circularity achieved by the building. A higher CI score indicates a higher level of circularity, meaning that the building is more sustainable and has a lower environmental impact. The CI can be used as a design tool to support the transition towards a circular construction industry, by providing feedback on the circularity of a building's design and construction process. The CI also takes into account the completeness of the data input, the efficiency of the recycling process, and the waste generated during the recycling process. Overall, the building circularity indicator provides a comprehensive assessment of the circularity of a building's construction, use, and end-of-life phases
